title: Hearthlight 00 is out: free cozy farming, cooking and pet sounds
body:
Hearthlight 00 is a free download of 27 cozy sound effects in WAV and OGG, including 5 seamless loops. It is a small demo cut of the three paid Hearthlight packs: 8 of the 107 sounds in Hearthlight 01 (farming), 9 of the 126 sounds in Hearthlight 02 (cooking) and 10 of the 126 sounds in Hearthlight 03 (pet care).

The point is to hear the line in your own game before you buy. Every file is byte for byte the file of the same name in the paid pack it comes from, so code wired for these files keeps working when you add a pack. Each pack runs every subject through the same chain of stages under the same file names: a crop from planting to harvest, a dish from the pantry to the plate, a pet from greeting to sleep.

What the paid packs add: every crop, dish and pet with every stage, every rung of the 5 ladders (sounds that climb with a number in your game, like a fuller basket, a hotter pan or a happier cat), every take of each variation set, and all the loops. 359 sounds between the three.

  • Hearthlight: Cozy Farming, From Seed to Harvest, $6.99
  • Hearthlight 02: Cozy Kitchen, From Pantry to Plate, $6.99
  • Hearthlight 03: Pet Care, From Greeting to Sleep, $6.99

What we measured: 256 signal checks on the download with 0 failures, and the loudness of the whole download sits inside 0.93 dB. These are signal measurements, not a claim that the sounds are good. Nobody at the studio can listen for you, which is what a free download is for.

Free for commercial games, no credit required. Everything is synthesised from code, no recordings and no sample libraries. The code was written with AI assistance and the cover and store graphics are AI generated; no generative audio model was used.
